sources.articleTitle: Buni presents N532bn 2027 budget to Yobe assembly

headline: Governors of Anambra and Yobe States Present 2027 Budget Proposals
seoTitle: Anambra and Yobe Governors Present 2027 Budgets
metaDescription: Governors in Nigeria present their state budget proposals for the 2027 fiscal year, outlining plans for recurrent spending and various capital projects.
aiSummaryBullets: Anambra State Governor proposed a total budget of 893.4 billion naira for 2027.
Yobe State Governor Mai Mala Buni submitted a 532.27 billion naira budget to the state assembly.
The budget proposals differentiate allocations between capital projects and recurrent expenditure.
aiContextParagraph: State governors in Nigeria have formally presented their financial plans for the 2027 fiscal year to their respective state assemblies. In Anambra, the administration unveiled an 893.4 billion naira budget, which earmarks 692.66 billion naira specifically for capital expenditure. Meanwhile, Yobe State Governor Mai Mala Buni presented a budget totaling 532.27 billion naira, marking his final budget presentation for his term. The Yobe proposal includes 288.4 billion naira designated for recurrent expenditure and 243.8 billion naira allocated to capital projects. These budgetary submissions serve as a critical step in the governance process, requiring legislative review and approval before funds can be officially disbursed for state operations and development initiatives across the two regions during the upcoming year.
whyItIsViral: This story is circulating due to concurrent reports from two major independent news outlets regarding state government budget presentations.
